analysis: site/batch audit — site predictability + label-site imbalance
note: Mean-pooled UNI embeddings -> TSS site prediction (5-fold CV macro-AUROC) + permutation null; endpoint label x site Cramér's V. Reuses existing embeddings and labels.
headline: In 4/4 cohorts H&E embeddings predict TSS site with macro-AUROC 0.95-0.99 (null ~0.50): strong site signature (Howard 2021). Label-site confounding varies by endpoint (severe for LUNG histology V=1.0 and GASTRIC Lauren 0.563; moderate for HPV/BRAF/EGFR/MSI). Site independence of endpoint signal requires LOSO.
